azkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillahi walhamdu lillahi

ar.text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ

en.text: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is due to Allah

azkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna

en.text: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we reach the evening

azkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant

ar.text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ

en.text: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant

ar.description: من قالها مئة مرة حطت عنه خطاياه

en.text: Glory be to Allah and all praise is due to Him
en.description: Whoever says it 100 times, his sins will be forgiven

ar.text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ

en.text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next
